summary: Implemented motor.force_distribution=hook_coupled_body_reaction as a paper-inspired approximation for the Kong et al. (2015) profiles. The flagellum-side hook-local drive and attach-neighborhood body reaction each have zero net force and opposite full torque vectors. Local body support falls back to all body beads only when degenerate. Single-run, generic campaign, and shape-stability manifests now distinguish dynamics, geometry, and simulation status and record reaction provenance, observed support bead counts, and fallback use. Both 2015 profiles remain pending and reject execution until Issues #166 and #168 are complete. Codex Cloud feedback was addressed by replacing axial-only torque matching with a six-constraint zero-force/full-vector-torque solver and adding a regression test on the 2010 triangular geometry.
non_blocking_issues: Issue #166 refined 120-bead geometry is not implemented, so the 2015 profiles remain implementation_status=pending.
Issue #168 motor-off 0.1 tau and motor-on 1 tau stability evaluation has not been run.
The new dynamics are explicitly paper_inspired_approximation and do not claim complete reproduction of the paper force placement.
